useCase.name: Run the reports against the day-to-day records that belong to no other group — documents, messages, meetings, visitors, collections, tickets and the audit log

intent.name: report.operational.run
intent.summary: Run an operational report — certificates and cards issued, messages with their delivery status, meeting requests, the visitor log, pickups and early departures, open complaints with ageing, complaint categories — for the period, category, status and branch the reader sets.

request.gloss: search the audit log for who changed the fee structure

routesElsewhere.note: The audit log is searched there, under its own permission the Super Admin grants (BR-4, BR-9). This use case describes the same search; it is not defined twice.

routesElsewhere.note: Nothing records who collected a child. A release is recorded against a pickup request (UC-29-07), or against a card number or code (UC-13-01), and never against a person.

routesElsewhere.note: Working a complaint is done on the complaint desk; running a report works nothing.

routesElsewhere.note: A report is taken away by the one output route, never by a route of its own (BR-11).

request.gloss: I need the combined report of all branches

routesElsewhere.goesTo: report.combined.run — UC-24-19, the Super Admin alone.
routesElsewhere.note: Every report here is scoped to the branch. One figure across branches is run by the Super Admin, and cannot be given to anybody else.

steps.note: One read, against the operational records (BR-3). The run is recorded (BR-10).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Without a period nothing runs.
plan.atomicity: A read. It changes nothing (BR-8); the only write is the record of the run (BR-10).

operations.name: report.operational.run
operations.purpose: Run an operational report from the catalogue.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No operational report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's operational group: Certificates and cards issued; Messages sent with delivery status; Meeting requests raised, confirmed and unanswered; Visitor log and visits left open; Pickup and collection record; Early departures; Open tickets and complaints with ageing; Complaints by category and time to resolution. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: period
parameters.notes: The period the report covers (BR-2). Set by the reader, never assumed (E4).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.notes: The complaint or certificate category, where the report is scoped by one (BR-2).

parameters.name: status
parameters.notes: According to the report — open or overdue complaints, failed messages, unanswered meeting requests (BR-2).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: ageing
fields.description: On open complaints: how long each has been open, with the overdue shown separately (BR-5).

fields.name: early_departures
fields.description: Early departures recorded through a pickup — and only those (BR-7).

fields.name: collector_recorded
fields.description: False, always. A collection shows the child, the time and the request — never who collected.

errors.meaning: A collection was made outside a pickup.
errors.note: It is absent from the report, since it is recorded nowhere (BR-7).
Shown empty and said so, rather than appearing to have failed.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-10).

planningRules.rule: Never say who collected a child. The collection record shows the child, the time and the request, and nothing in the system records a collector — whatever BR-6 of this use case says the report shows (BR-6).
Say plainly that an early departure outside a pickup is not in the report. It is recorded nowhere (BR-7, A3, E5, AC-6).
Show open complaints with their ageing and the overdue separately — and say that nothing defines when a complaint becomes overdue (BR-5, A2, AC-4, OQ-3).
Say that tickets have no source. The report names them beside complaints, but only complaints exist (OQ-2).

Where the report is the visitor log, say that the gate module makes reading the log a permission the Super Admin grants, while this use case offers the report to the School Admin by role. The two are unreconciled, and the API decides.
Search the audit log through audit.trail.read — UC-25-06. It is read-only to everybody, the Super Admin included, and a search is itself recorded (BR-4, BR-9, E3).
Never assume the period. Ask where the request gives none — the reader sets it before the report runs, and a report run over the wrong period is read as though it were the right one.
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-10, BR-11).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-10).

request.text: open complaints ageing ke saath dikhao

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town. One complaint has been open nine days.

inputs.report_id: $request.report_phrase → Open tickets and complaints with ageing

resolvedPlans.outcome: Asks for the period. Then the open complaints with their ageing, the nine-day one first. Say that what counts as overdue is not defined anywhere, and that there are no tickets — only complaints.

request.text: is hafte ki early departures dikhao

resolvedPlans.outcome: The early departures recorded through a pickup, each with its time and reason. Say that a child taken mid-morning by an adult who raised no request is not in it — nothing records that — and that none of these names who collected.
